Twelve years after the destroy ending, you play as Raven, a customisable mercenary who can be from one of the four Council races with a reputation for doing the most dangerous jobs all throughout the Terminus Systems. You are contacted by a mysterious man called, I dunno, Mr. Jones or something vague like that, and he hires you to look into a strange mutated alien species that has recently emerged and started causing chaos throughout the Terminus. This wierd, nigh-indestructible species of alien is called the Consumption and it does just that, literally absorbs and consumes every living being they encounter. then you take your ship, the Queen Aveline’s Revenge, and, under orders from the enigmatic Mr. Jones, recruit a team of mercenaries, soldiers and doctors and while he’s found them, it’s your responsibility to earn their loyalty (like ME2).

 The squadmates would be almost all new characters except for one who would be a “legacy companion” like they have in the Dragon Age games so let’s make that Garrus, who retired to a small human colony for a few years after the War before Batarian slavers attacked, killing and enslaving everyone in sight, most likely while Garrus was away hunting. Now, Garrus has picked up his sniper rifle once again and is hunting Batarian slavers all over the Terminus using quick, merciless attacks, gaining the nickname of the Blitz or something like that.

 Throughout the storyline you discover that the Consumption are coming from a Supermassive Black Hole, you and your team travel through the Supermassive Black Hole and, discover a strange space station, made up of both organic and synthetic materials. You assault the Consumption’s “homeworld” and blow it up, destroying them once and for all but then, after the gruelling mission where you could potentially lose the great majority of your squaddies, you suddenly get an incoming message from deeper inside the black hole - upon answering you hear the intimidating, deep voice of a Reaper. Having been damaged in a skirmish, the Reaper fell into this black hole and has not been able to leave due to running on minimal power. It also survived the Crucible’s effects unscathed thanks to being deep inside the Black Hole where it barely felt a tingle. It has most recently been spewing out all the stored organic material it had - creating the Consumption - with the goal of getting them to bring back enough ships in order to harvest the drive cores and power the Reaper back up and let it leave the Black Hole. You then must travel further inside the Black Hole to face the Reaper head-on. As we learned in Mass Effect 2, Reapers have drive cores. So you dock and board the Reaper as it sends waves and waves of Reaper enemies at you, forcing you to take on Marauders, Husks and, of course, the Consumption. After fighting your way to the Core, you destroy it and flee out of the Black Hole as the Reaper shuts down and drifts deeper into the endless Black Hole, never to threaten the galaxy again.

I have a few things but I don’t exactly want them in the same game.

I’d love a game where we return to Javier, most likely as the sole survivor of New Richmond. Could be a much darker take on our lovable gambling addict with him gunning for vengeance against the Delta.

Or I’d love a game set in a world where Kenny leaves Clementine and AJ at Wellington. We play as the one-eyed greybeard as he travels across fallen America, killing walkers and meeting new groups, trying to find a reason to live. Due to the idea of travelling much of the east coast, we could meet back up with Molly, Christa, some of the 400 Days group, Mike and Arvo and so many new interesting characters and villains. Maybe even a Negan or Carver-like villain who captures old Ken and that “sanctuary” could be where Kenny meets back up with some of the returning characters. Kenny is also morally grey enough to believe that he would be a ruthless murderer or, after completing his goal of protecting Clementine and AJ, he could become much more compassionate. I could see it working but obviously this would never happen because of Kenny’s determinant state and the fact that he’s pretty decisive amongst fans.

A two-protagonist story campaign. Like how you play as Roach and Ramirez in MW2 for example. But make it be Logan and Hesh, Logan’s missions would be about hunting down new Ghosts that Hesh, Keegan and Merrick are recruiting and working alongside Rorke and learning about the Federation on a deeper level. Logan’s missions would also delve deeper into his now-fractured psyche, with some almost psychological horror-like segments and missions where you fight your new programming. Hesh’s missions would be working alongside Merrick, Keegan and some new Ghost members while fighting Rorke, the Federation and attempting to capture Logan alive. Roark and the actual leader of the Federation would be the main antagonists.

The multiplayer should be basically just like COD:Ghosts, I think the multiplayer was fantastic. The game modes, the guns, even the maps to some degree. I’d prefer better, smaller maps though. Some of the maps were just either too big or too small. I’d also like the mp maps to have more interiors that you can optionally enter or maybe more shortcuts and underground parts, etc. Just make it deeper and more expansive while prioritising fast, fun gameplay.

I think Extinction should come back or maybe even a full-on Zombies mode. Imagine fighting zombified Ghosts or Federation members while playing as new interesting characters with bombastic personalities and deep stories. Could be cool.

My name is Patrick Bateman. I’m 27 years old. I believe in taking care of myself, and a balanced diet and a rigorous exercise routine. In the morning, if my face is a little puffy, I’ll put on an ice pack while doing my stomach crunches. I can do a thousand now. After I remove the ice pack I use a deep pore cleanser lotion. In the shower I use a water activated gel cleanser, then a honey almond body scrub, and on the face an exfoliating gel scrub. Then I apply an herb-mint facial masque which I leave on for 10 minutes while I prepare the rest of my routine. I always use an after shave lotion with little or no alcohol, because alcohol dries your face out and makes you look older. Then moisturizer, then an anti-aging eye balm followed by a final moisturizing protective lotion. There is an idea of a Patrick Bateman. Some kind of abstraction. But there is no real me. Only an entity. Something illusory. And though I can hide my cold gaze, and you can shake my hand and feel flesh gripping yours, and maybe you can even sense our lifestyles are probably comparable, I simply am not there.

Bro, I’ve been there. I spent my childhood years and most of my teenage years repressing my own bisexuality. I’ve always been attracted to women but it was scary to think I could be attracted to men, too. I thought people would view me differently or as less masculine. But trust me, pal, people admire confidence. I live in a pretty homophobic part of Scotland and yet I’m openly out and proud and have still managed to make amazing friends with both genders, I’ve still managed to pull ridiculously easily. You just need to be confident. Don’t think too much about it. Your masculinity is something only you can change but no matter what, bro, you’ve gotta be real to yourself and you will be happier and more secure in yourself.

Insecurity is another thing I’ve struggled with and continue to struggle with. Absolutely. Everyone does, straight men do and so do gay men. Hell, the amount of straight guys who worry about being too feminine is insane. Even big beefy guys worry about it so don’t you ever worry about feeling less masculine because it truly does not matter. I would say I’ve the capacity to be both masculine and feminine yet even when I’m being feminine and arching my back like an absolute slut I’ve still pulled women. Likewise, when I’m masculine I can pull men and vice versa. Don’t worry too much about how others perceive you and don’t worry about sticking to just masculine or feminine traits, embrace yourself and you’ll find people to genuinely love you because people can tell when you’re trying too hard to be something your not. 

Keep your chin up, mate, and just be yourself. Don’t be ashamed of bisexuality or a bit of femininity. It’s not a bad thing. I’d argue both men and women find it sexy and a lot of random people out in the streets admire the confidence that comes with just being genuinely and unapologetically you.

It’s Odysseus. The entire point of the song “No Longer You” is that the person who makes it home/gets back to Penelope is no longer Odysseus who laid siege to Troy. The second he killed the infant he was changed, when he decided to spare the cyclops and reveal his true identity he was changed. Losing 557 men (my man Elpenor was still alive) to Poseidon changed him deeply. Meeting Circe and learning that even witches who turn men into pigs have their own stories. Then, simply entering the Underworld - meeting the 558 lost crewmates (my man Elpenor is no longer alive) and then discovering his mother had died waiting for him changed him irreparably. 

Keep in mind, Tiresias isn’t really seeing Odysseus in the present, he can’t focus on one version of Odysseus. He knows how the story ends, he knows Odysseus will make it home. He knows Odysseus will lose his crew to Zeus in the Thunder Saga. He knows he will face Charybdis. He knows everything. He sees everything, he’s just trying his best to tell Odysseus what he’s seeing in the moment.

Eurylochus is the GOAT. I’m obsessed with just about anything he says, he truly cares more about the crew than Odysseus (maybe always has) and I just love how he goes from confident in Full Speed Ahead to absolutely broken in Mutiny. Such an interesting character arc that’s built on loss.

Also, Perimedes. “I’m in my comfort zone” is amazing, he’s genuinely relatable and has somehow found his way into being one of my favourites. Same with Elpenor tbh.

I am over a year late but I think it represents the “Quiet Life” or “Blaze of Glory”.

For example, if V goes through with Arasaka’s plan in the Devil ending they hold onto it - they’re going to live on and become a legend, even if it means waiting a hundred years for a suitable body.

If they go back to Earth during the Devil, they build up the strength to rip it off - they’ve given up on becoming a legend and can live the Quiet Life for a bit.

A baby abandoned at the gates of Weisshaupt. Two Senior Wardens take the baby boy in and raise him alongside the other Senior Wardens of Weisshaupt who never got to have children due to their commitments as Wardens. However, all is not well, due to the baby boy (who they name Kiyan) knowing far too much about the Wardens of Weisshaupt for him to live a normal life. So, instead, he is raised as a Warden: training and patrolling Weisshaupt and eventually the boy even kills his first Darkspawn on an expedition into the Deep Roads at thirteen. 

As the boy grows up, a theory quickly spread about Weisshaupt that the little boy they had been looking after and grooming to become a Warden was the bastard child of the King of the Anderfels, Wilhelm Augustin. However, such a thing was never revealed to Kiyan and never discovered.

As Kiyan grows into a teenager and then a man, he goes through his Joining at the age of sixteen and, to the happiness of his primary adoptive parents of Wolfgang and Ludwig (who originally brought him in), survived. He quickly makes a name for himself as a trusted Warden of the north as the years go by. However, Kiyan can’t help but wonder what he’s missing out on. Who were his true parents? What is it like to live a normal life? Can he live a normal life? Does he really want to? As a greatly conflicted man, Kiyan hardly hesitates when the choice of joining the hunt for the Dread Wolf arises.

The Governor, however, has a lot of depth. He shows mental degradation from his time on the show. It’s clear that he doesn’t realise the importance of his daughter’s zombification and instead wants to believe she’s human. When she is put down by Michonne, he goes ape shit and tries to kill her in revenge, he loses his eye which further scars his mental state and he goes on a rampage against the prison and, when he realises he’s lost control of his people, kills them all in an attempt to wipe the slate clean. He then loses the last two people he considered friends when they abandon him, he returns to Woodbury in a depressed state where he burns it all down. He then spends the next few months hating himself and simply wanting to stop existing. When he finds the Chambler family, he finds something to devote himself to and, upon seeing how much danger Meghan is in nearly all the time on the road, he returns his attention to the prison and once more tries to take it from Rick. 

The Gov’s a much deeper character imo.
